# Aesthedent CMS content architecture audit

## Current implementation reconciliation — 2026-10-17

This section supersedes the historical seven-model inventory below. Current source registers **14 models and 856 compiled field/member paths**; inherited image/Portable Text storage paths are not independent editorial controls. The initial audit is retained as historical evidence, not current implementation status.

- Source target: ae09qs5c / production, /aesthedent-studio. English-only routes remain unchanged.
- Fresh published snapshot: 2026-10-17T09:54:30.809Z; zero across 14 types. Authenticated drafts/releases/assets inventory is unavailable, not confirmed empty.
- Dry-run: 26 candidates, six permission-blocked reviews, 131 page-copy traces, 1163 payload leaf traces, 37 image consumer/source entries reconciled to finite record destinations; 23 native image schema controls (12 original + 11 SEO), 23 social-image document destinations. These counts measure different things. No remote operations prepared/applied. Manifest SHA-256: a3c5086268aa8535dba06f9e949d221c5e89e51b10b3ef2871ba7e0b18cc35da.
- 82 automated tests (final command), global and strict CMS TypeScript, production build 48.78s / 29 generated pages, SEO 308/0; 22/22 HTML baselines match public content, header/footer, links, images, search metadata, language and JSON-LD. Complete nested social metadata intentionally fixes the audited inheritance gaps. Root OG/canonical trailing-slash normalization is equivalent.
- HTTP: 29 expected responses (22 public, sitemap, robots, three Studio paths, unknown-treatment 404, preview-enable 503). No live draft/publish/cache-refresh claim.
- Browser: authenticated Home and Navigation New templates/status/help inspected read-only. Later connection-refused/error-page policy blocked Contact and a reconnection; stopped after two attempts. Other editors, mobile menu interaction, authenticated preview and content delivery need human acceptance.

Home/About/Experience retain their existing bounded objects and shared records; About adds only the clinic-experience eyebrow. The brand promise/statistics, provider/credential/facility/clinical claims, fixed Experience process/video, contacts, directions, hours, appointment flow, legal/analytics and layout remain code-owned or blocked for clinic decisions. New page models cover presentation only. servicesPage.detail owns shared treatment headings/actions; insightsPage.detail owns article sidebar/related copy. No duplicate doctors, treatments, articles or reviews are nested in page documents. Header/footer presentation uses navigation; phone, WhatsApp, icons, destinations for operational actions and active/responsive behavior remain in code.

### Synchronization, migration and rollback gate

Ten singleton families: homePage, aboutPage, experiencePage, servicesPage, teamPage, insightsPage, contactPage, localLandingPage, navigation, seoSettings. New singleton drafts use drafts.<type>. Eight treatment, two doctor and six Insight identities remain existing slugs/keys; existing published IDs are preserved, new ordinary draft IDs come from Sanity and are journaled. Reviews remain blocked.

The default command `node scripts/sync-cms-content.mjs` only writes ignored local evidence under .cache/content-sync. Before draft application, restore authenticated raw inventory for the exact target, include published/draft/release families and native assets, rerun the dry-run and review draft-plan.json and manifest.json. Existing values, explicit blanks and keyed arrays are preserved; changed values are reported as preserved-conflict. Arrays with differing positions/identities are blocked. Missing paths alone use setIfMissing under the saved revision. A copied published document retains its existing values; nested additions require a reviewed draft first.

Application requires an explicitly approved JSON file with projectId, dataset, manifestHash and operationsHash for that exact fresh plan. Every operation checks the family and revision, journals started/committed/verified with fsync, reads back the payload/revision and checks the family again. The cross-document family check is not a global transaction/lock; a race between preflight and mutation can leave a committed-but-unverified draft and stops the batch. Unknown SDK outcomes remain uncertain. Never retry blindly or delete drafts automatically. Fresh inventory and a new exact approval are mandatory before resume. The local backup and per-operation journal identify recovery candidates; rollback is a separate revision-guarded, reviewed plan, never an automatic delete/revert.

No remote document can be named/revised safely until authenticated inventory exists. Candidate payloads are not populated documents and the zero-operation plan is not permission to apply later. Shared SEO defaults copy existing metadata only; page overrides and image assets remain unset until reviewed. Existing native image sources are never fabricated; every consumer resolves to exact static source/record identities. Social images use exact existing article sources or /homepage-banner.png, with a separate destination and crop/alt decision.

### Editorial transition, SEO, media and preview

Fresh zero-published snapshot was inspected before considering the changed review digest for rollout. There is no published Insight to silently remove in that snapshot; unknown drafts/releases still require inventory/review. All publication-relevant article SEO, imagery, copy, links, dates and attribution participate in recorded sign-off; edits invalidate eligibility. Imports stay draft/unapproved with no invented clinician sources or authors. Approval must be genuinely re-recorded for any affected existing draft.

SEO uses existing Insight title/description fields and one resolver. Shared title/description fill absent fallback metadata (including homepage); shared OG/Twitter text applies to homepage/default social output; shared native imagery fills missing page social imagery. Existing route-specific metadata wins unless that page explicitly overrides it. Shared settings cannot deindex, nofollow or recanonicalize the site. Canonicals permit known internal routes only, default self; chains/cycles, noindex targets and conflicting signals fail safely. Explanations are required for cross-page canonical, noindex or nofollow. Sitemap excludes noindex/cross-canonical URLs, retains nofollow-only pages and always reads published content. Robots crawl policy stays code-owned. Structured-data controls only wrap supported existing page builders and visible content, never raw JSON-LD or clinic facts.

Images preserve high-resolution originals, native crop/hotspot, responsive optimized derivatives and failed-delivery fallback. Guides specify subject/composition/ratio/dimensions and alt; dimensions are warnings, not arbitrary upload/megapixel caps. Native selection/upload/permission is blocked until verified separately.

Preview is installed locally but **off by default**. Optional variables: SANITY_API_READ_TOKEN (server-only, least-privilege read token), NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_PREVIEW_ENABLED (explicit activation flag). No env file was changed. Enabling Presentation may create a Sanity preview-secret document; obtain explicit authorization before activating it. The installed defineEnableDraftMode validates the secret before Next issues its signed draft cookie. Authenticated preview uses drafts perspective/no-store, shows an unpublished/possibly unapproved notice, allows unapproved Insight drafts without a false clinician badge, forces page noindex/nofollow, and has a same-origin POST exit. Public ISR stays published-only/60 seconds; this is request-driven freshness, not a guaranteed propagation deadline. Saved-draft/secret/cookie and real cache-cycle acceptance remain blocked.

### Current issue disposition

- **G01 P1 — Prefill awaits authenticated inventory and exact payload approval:** Blocked: no remote apply.
- **G02 P1 — Singleton and collection document-family preflight:** Implemented locally; actual GROQ release-race tests pass.
- **G03 P1 — Durable per-operation receipts and partial-failure handling:** Implemented; disk fsync, read-back and interrupted-batch tests pass.
- **G04 P1 — Finite public presentation coverage:** Implemented locally; protected/code-owned copy explicitly retained.
- **G05 P1 — Authenticated unpublished website preview:** Local implementation tested; activation and live draft acceptance blocked.
- **G06 P2 — Bounded navigation and footer:** Implemented locally; existing structure and operational CTAs preserved.
- **G07 P2 — Advanced SEO resolver and sitemap policy:** Implemented locally; canonical/indexing combinations tested.
- **G08 P2 — Complete route-specific social metadata:** 22 rebuilt routes have self-route social URLs, images and Twitter titles.
- **G09 P2 — Media source/destination reconciliation:** Dynamic consumers resolved locally; native asset inventory/permission/upload remain gated.
- **G10 P2 — Editorial status and editor acceptance:** Status banner, groups and impact help implemented; saved/published journey remains open.

Keep patient/review-count, clinician/provider/registration and clinical-claim conflicts, testimonial permission, A11 unknown-Insight behavior and separately scoped A14 appointment security concern open. Clinic hours are unchanged. No IVF model, locale, approval policy or data is copied.

### Current field-by-field matrix

Each model chain above supplies schema → query → runtime → consumer. SEO fields instead use sanity/schemaTypes/seo.ts → sanity/lib/seo.ts (Insight's reviewed query for article controls) → seo-mapping.ts → route metadata/sitemap/allowed JSON-LD. Image and Portable Text internals are listed for reconciliation completeness, not as additional business controls. Custom validation also uses document-level rules; optional means optional locally, not permission to bypass required base content.

Rules: [{"flag":"type","constraint":"Object"},{"flag":"assetRequired","constraint":{"assetType":"image"}},{"flag":"type","constraint":"Object"},{"flag":"custom","constraint":"custom"}]. Wide landscape, about 16:9. Cards crop near 16:10, detail to 21:9 and social previews to 1200:630. Keep the subject central and check every crop; use approved editorial imagery. Recommended 1600 × 900px or higher resolution. Original uploads are preserved; the website serves responsive optimized crops. Set the hotspot on the subject and check narrow/wide previews. Dimensions are guidance, not upload limits. Select an existing approved asset or upload a permitted image. Add alternative text describing the selected image. Leave unset to retain the original website image. CMS / fallback.

2026-10-17 · documentation-only · local working tree is the authority

## 1. Executive summary and evidence

Verified: seven registered models provide bounded editorial overrides, not full-page control. `homePage` owns only the visit section; Home also consumes four shared collections. Current static fallback protects all known public routes. The recommended target is additive named page sections with fixed presentation, not a generic page builder. No P0 defect was independently reproduced. A01 is an editor-selection mismatch; factual/permission issues remain unresolved.

Target: `ae09qs5c` / `production`, `/aesthedent-studio`, localhost3001. English root; no active locale routing/model. Source evidence is current; clinic truth/permission is not certified by this audit.

Evidence labels: **Source** means actual current code/compiled schema; **HTTP** means fresh local server response; **Browser** means current read-only hydrated UI; **Historical** means retained prior verification; **Recommendation** is unimplemented. /**
 * Every string the intake wizard renders. The component holds no copy of its
 * own, so changing what a patient reads means editing this file and nothing
 * else.
 *
 * SHAPE NOTE: there are 9 entries in `steps` but the labels read "of 8".
 * `contactMethod` and `phone` deliberately share "Step 6 of 8" and render on
 * one screen -the spec offers "A phone call" as a contact method, so a number
 * has to be collected or a patient who asks to be called cannot be called.
 * Screens are derived by grouping consecutive entries that share a `label`;
 * see getScreens() in ./intake-form-types.
 *
 * BOUNDARY: this form collects triage context only. No symptom branching, no
 * clinical follow-ups, no suggested treatment. A form that appears to triage is
 * making a clinical claim this site is not allowed to make.
 */
export const INTAKE_FORM = {
  eyebrow: "We're here when you're ready",
  title: "Let's get you seen, comfortably.",
  intro: "Tell us a little about what's going on. No forms with fifty fields -just a short conversation, and we'll take it from there.",

  steps: [
    {

      required: true,
    },
    {

      type: "single-select",
      columns: 2,
      required: true,
      options: [
        { value: "Myself" },
        { value: "My child" },
        { value: "A parent" },

      ],
    },
    {
      id: "reason",
      label: "Step 3 of 8",
      question: "What brings you in?",
      type: "single-select",
      columns: 1,
      required: true,
      options: [
        { value: "Tooth pain or sensitivity", sub: "Something's hurting and needs a look" },
        { value: "Missing tooth / implants",  sub: "Replacing one or more teeth" },
        { value: "Root canal concern",        sub: "Suspected infection or old RCT pain" },
        { value: "Smile design / cosmetic",   sub: "Whitening, veneers, alignment" },
        { value: "Routine check-up",          sub: "Cleaning, cavity check, general health" },
        { value: "Something else",            sub: "We'll ask you to explain below" },

## 3. Homepage content specification

Render order is fixed in HomeClient. No general section add/remove/reorder control exists. Server page concurrently reads Insights, services, doctors, testimonials and visit singleton. A missing CMS collection does not remove its static cards. Exact current SSR text is reproduced below, together with source literals/props where responsive or conditional states differ. These are inventory values, not clinical approval.

Accessible H1 comes from HERO_HEADING. CTA labels and tracking remain code-owned; WhatsApp message derived from clinic constants. Scroll and animated spans are decorative. No CMS hero field. Our TeamMeet your dentists in KothrudDr. Sahil and Dr. Aishwarya bring precision and genuine patience to every case — walking you through it step by step, so nothing catches you by surprise.Plenty of people arrive here having avoided a dentist for years, and nobody is going to make you feel foolish about that. If that is you, read what we do for patients who are frightened of the dentist before you book, or how we work with nervous patients. You set the pace; raise a hand and everything stops. If you are just trying to work out where we are and when we are open, our dental clinic in Kothrud page has the practical detail.Lead Dentist & FounderDr. Sahil WathodkarSpecialist Prosthodontist, Founder & Co-OwnerBDS, MDS (Prosthodontics) - Bharati Vidyapeeth, PuneSpecializes in implants and restorative dentistry with a focus on patient education and comfort.Dental SurgeonDr. Aishwarya Kulkarni WathodkarGeneral & Family Dentist, Co-OwnerBDS - Bharati Vidyapeeth, PuneAdvanced training in endodontics and pregnancy dentistry. Known for her calm, thorough approach.Meet the full team01We Are Open On Weekends AlsoWe understand your busy schedule. That's why we offer weekend appointments, ensuring you can prioritize your dental health without compromising your weekday commitments.02Purposeful CommunicationClear vision leads to clear confidence. We prioritize face-to-face consultations, using advanced intraoral imaging not just to diagnose, but to educate. Our goal is for you to leave with a complete understanding of your oral health, not just a prescription.03Sensory TransparencyThe fear of dentistry is often a fear of the unexpected. We bridge that gap by narrating each step of your treatment in real-time-preparing you for every vibration, sound, or sensation. When you know exactly what’s coming, the anxiety fades.04Your Safety, Your SignalEthical care means you are always the primary decision-maker. We implement a specific 'rest signal' before any treatment begins. If you raise your hand, our tools are down instantly. You have our word that we pause as often and for as long as you need.Control Signal active

Published boundary: server-only client uses published perspective, CDN off, stega off,5-second timeout/no retries. Explicit GROQ excludes drafts.* and versions.*. services[0...9] detects excess above8; doctors[0...3] above2; testimonials[0...7] above6; singleton[0...2] above1; Insights known slugs[0...7] above6. Services/doctors/singletons queried broadly then checked against allowed identities; Insights unknown slugs are query-excluded as well as runtime checked. Testimonial query excludes documents lacking either true attestation; those absent slots use static quotations.

Reads use force-cache,60-second Next revalidation and per-model tags (`insights`, `services`, `doctors`, `testimonials`, `home-page`, `about-page`, `experience-page`) plus React request memoization. No webhook, draft preview or token-bearing browser fetch. Missing data is quiet; invalid/ambiguous and query/config failures have distinct generic logging. API failure does not become an empty public page. This is request-driven stale-while-revalidate, not a guaranteed60-second publication deadline or cross-route atomic update.

## 5. Field-by-field schema assessment

The following catalog is generated from the installed compiled schema and checked against queries/mappers/consumers. Parent order is one-based inside its object; groups inherited below are editor grouping context, not extra nested groups. “Required” records field-local presence; root Zod/conditional rules can be stronger. Built-in slug/current/source and Portable Text payload fields are distinguished from explicit editorial controls. Generated `_id`, `_type`, `_key`, `_rev`, timestamps are not separate editable schema fields; runtime key/type rules are described on body. Primitive array members are included.

### service — Treatment

Existing treatments only. Use clinic-reviewed clinical copy. Images, locality, navigation labels, icons and ordering remain in code; no prices or new capabilities are introduced.

Groups/order: summary (Identity and summaries, default) → detail (Treatment page) → process (Benefits and steps) → questions (FAQs) Initial value: `null`. Ordinary document IDs generated by Sanity except singleton IDs homePage/aboutPage/experiencePage. All seven use document-level contentErrors; singleton fixed ID checked in document and runtime.

### experiencePage — Experience content and FAQs

Existing clinical explanations only. Have the clinic verify claims about equipment, sedation and outcomes. Media, hours, offers and structural sections remain in code.

Groups/order: explanations (Care explanations, default) → questions (FAQs) Initial value: `null`. Ordinary document IDs generated by Sanity except singleton IDs homePage/aboutPage/experiencePage. All seven use document-level contentErrors; singleton fixed ID checked in document and runtime.

Preview: Constant section-specific title; no content preview pane or draft website preview. These are list/member previews, not live website previews. See exact schema source; ordinary populated-document preview readability was not browser-verified.

### Additional structural and editorial rules

Stable slug validation calls the published counterpart and fails closed on access errors; built-in slug uniqueness remains. Runtime duplicate checks protect API writes but Studio validation is not an atomic datastore constraint. Insight Featured validation includes static fallback Featured flags and published peers, allows turning Featured off to repair, rejects ambiguous/error lookup. Testimonial slot uniqueness uses raw perspective to include other drafts/published documents while excluding its own pair and versions; no remote uniqueness guarantee is inferred.

Home initialValue supplies six stable stage names/keys only, no content. `newDocumentOptions` hides arbitrary singleton create choices while retaining initialization templates; Structure fixes documentId. Only duplicate action is filtered for singleton types; this is not a permissions/security boundary or a guarantee no API can create a wrong-ID document. Wrong IDs/duplicate models trigger safe fallback. About/Experience initial values contain no approved copy and require full validated content. Array member titles/descriptions are explicit content, generated keys remain editor-managed.

### Complete non-homepage implemented section values

These expandable entries reconcile every actual known public route/section with current text, actions, assets and ownership; repeated service/detail routes intentionally remain separate because content differs. Static parent introductions/actions can coexist with CMS-owned nested data. Source expressions/props document hidden branches; SSR capture alone does not test clicks.

Our StoryBorn from a Simple BeliefAesthedent Multispeciality Dental Clinic was founded by Dr. Sahil Wathodkar with a simple vision: to create a dental clinic where patients actually want to come. A place where fear is replaced with comfort, where every treatment is explained clearly, and where honesty guides every recommendation.After years of seeing patients avoid dental care due to fear or past negative experiences, Dr. Sahil Wathodkar knew there had to be a better way. He invested in the latest painless dentistry techniques, created a calm, modern environment, and built a team that shares his patient-first philosophy.Today, Aesthedent has served over 5,000 patients in Kothrud and beyond. Our 5-star rating isn't just a number-it's a reflection of the trust our patients place in us every day.

Clinical Q&AHonest answers to the most common patient concerns.Why should I choose dental implants over dentures?Dental implants are fixed titanium roots that wont slip or fall out. They preserve your jawbone, maintain facial structure, and act exactly like natural teeth, unlike removable dentures.Are dental implants or wisdom tooth surgery painful?With modern local anesthesia, you feel minimal discomfort during the procedure. Most patients report only mild pressure. Post-operative soreness is easily managed with prescribed medication.How many sittings are required for a Root Canal (RCT)?Depending on the severity of infection, RCT may be completed in one or multiple sittings. Early intervention usually means a simpler, faster procedure.Am I too old for Braces or Aligners?Not at all! Orthodontic treatment is suitable for teenagers, young professionals, and even patients in their 40s or beyond. Discreet options like clear aligners make it lifestyle-friendly.Will my smile look natural after Full Mouth Rehabilitation?Absolutely. We place special emphasis on smile design, tooth proportions, and bite harmony so that your new smile is perfectly proportionate to your face.How long do dental implants last?With proper care and regular follow-ups, dental implants can last 10–15 years or even a lifetime. They are a long-term investment in your health.Why are tooth colored fillings better than silver ones?They match your natural tooth shade perfectly, bond more strongly to the structure, and are far more conservative of your original enamel.

Where our patients come fromMost people who come to us live within a few minutes of the clinic — Kothrud itself, and the Karve Nagar side. For anything urgent that is simply how it should be; nobody sensibly crosses Pune with an abscess, and a filling is not worth a forty-minute drive.Orthodontic patients tend to be local for a different reason. Braces mean a short appointment roughly every month for a year and a half, so the cumulative travel matters far more than people expect when they start. If you are weighing up clinics for a treatment that long, distance deserves more weight than it usually gets.The longer trips are the planned ones. People come from Bavdhan and Warje for implant work, and from Erandwane and Deccan for dentures and full mouth rehabilitation — treatments where you are choosing a clinician rather than a postcode, and where it is reasonable to travel a bit further to get the planning right.

<details>
<summary>Implemented text, actions and assets</summary>

**Current SSR text**

About Dental Implants in KothrudMissing teeth affect more than your smile -they compromise chewing efficiency, jawbone density, and long-term oral health. Dental implants remain the gold standard for tooth replacement, functioning as true root substitutes rather than surface-level fixes like dentures or bridges. Each implant is a biocompatible titanium fixture, surgically placed into the jawbone, where it undergoes osseointegration -fusing with your natural bone to create a stable, load-bearing foundation for a custom crown, bridge, or full-arch restoration.At Aesthedent, dental implant treatment in Kothrud, Pune is planned and executed under the direct supervision of a specialist prosthodontist -a dental professional with advanced, additional training in tooth replacement and restorative dentistry. Treatment begins with detailed clinical evaluation and 3D imaging (CBCT) to assess bone quality and map implant positioning with sub-millimeter precision. This diagnostic-first approach reduces surgical risk and improves long-term implant survival rates.Every procedure is performed under controlled local anesthesia, with protocols designed around patient comfort, minimal downtime, and predictable healing. From initial consultation through final restoration, each stage is guided by prosthodontic expertise -not general practice guesswork -to ensure implants that function, feel, and last like natural teeth for 10–15 years or longer.Patients travel to us from Bavdhan and Warje for implant work, largely because this is a decision people research rather than make on proximity -and it is worth asking whoever plans your case what their qualification actually is.

The ProcessWhat to expect, step by step1Clinical evaluation and CBCT imagingA detailed examination followed by 3D imaging to assess bone volume and density, and to map the implant position against the nerve and sinus anatomy.2Prosthodontic planningThe final restoration is designed first, then the implant position is derived from it. FAQsCommon questionsWhat is a dental implant, exactly?A titanium post placed into the jawbone to act as an artificial tooth root. Once the bone has grown around it, it carries a crown, bridge or denture. It is fixed in place rather than removable.Why would I choose an implant over a bridge or a denture?An implant replaces a single tooth without cutting down the healthy teeth on either side, which a bridge requires. Against a denture, it is fixed rather than removable and loads the bone more naturally. It is not always the right answer, though - for some cases a bridge is simpler and just as durable, and we will say so.Does it hurt?The placement is done under local anaesthetic, which is tested before we start. Most people describe the sensation as pressure rather than pain. Afterwards you can expect soreness for a few days, managed with ordinary painkillers. Everyone's experience differs, which is why we would rather tell you what to expect than promise you a feeling.How long do dental implants last?Published survival data for implants is high over ten to fifteen years and many last considerably longer. Yours depends on the bone it sits in, how your bite loads it, whether you smoke, and how well the area is cleaned - which is why we review it rather than fit it and wave you off.How long does the whole thing take?Usually several months, most of which is waiting rather than treatment. The implant needs time to integrate with the bone before the final tooth can be loaded onto it. We will give you the stages and rough timings for your case at the planning visit.What if I do not have enough bone?It is common, particularly if the tooth has been missing for years, and it does not automatically rule an implant out. The scan tells us what is there. If grafting is needed we will explain what that adds in time and cost before you decide anything.What does a dental implant cost in Pune?It depends on the number of implants, the system used and whether any grafting is needed. We give you a written figure after the scan and the planning discussion, before any treatment is booked - we would rather you compared a real number than a starting price.I have been putting this off because I am frightened. Is that a problem?No, and you are in a large group. Tell us when you book and we will run the appointment differently: more explanation, more breaks, and a hand signal that stops everything immediately.

**Current SSR text**

About Root Canal Treatment in KothrudA root canal treatment (RCT) is a procedure that removes infected or inflamed pulp -the nerve and blood vessel tissue inside your tooth -to eliminate infection at its source. At Aesthedent in Kothrud, Pune, root canal treatment is handled by Dr. Aishwarya Kulkarni Wathodkar, BDS, who has advanced training in endodontics (root canal treatment), using digital X-rays and rotary endodontic techniques for precise, minimally invasive treatment.Unlike an extraction, RCT lets you retain your natural tooth structure -which remains the gold standard in dental care, since no artificial replacement fully matches the strength and function of a natural tooth. With modern anesthesia and single-sitting protocols where clinically appropriate, the procedure is far more comfortable than most patients expect.Ignoring the early signs of pulp infection -lingering sensitivity to hot or cold, pain while chewing, or a darkening tooth -allows the infection to spread into the surrounding bone, often leading to an abscess, worsening pain, and eventual tooth loss. Early diagnosis means a simpler, faster procedure and quicker relief. If you're experiencing tooth pain in Kothrud or the surrounding Pune area, timely evaluation at Aesthedent can help save your natural tooth before the infection advances.Because an infected tooth is urgent and nobody wants to cross the city with one, most of these patients come from Kothrud itself and the Paud Road side. If you are in pain today, phone rather than email.

**Current SSR text**

FAQsCommon questionsIs a root canal painful?The procedure relieves pain rather than causing it - what hurts is the infected nerve you arrive with. Under local anaesthetic most people say it feels similar to having a filling. Some soreness for a few days afterwards is normal and settles with ordinary painkillers.How many appointments will I need?One or two for most teeth, depending on how many canals it has and how much infection is present. Molars take longer than front teeth. We will tell you which after the X-ray rather than after we have started.Can I just have the tooth out instead?You can, and it is usually cheaper on the day. But the gap then needs managing - the teeth either side drift, and replacing it later with a bridge or implant costs more than the root canal would have. We will lay out both options honestly.Do I really need a crown afterwards?Often, yes. A tooth that has had its nerve removed becomes more brittle and back teeth take heavy biting forces, so they tend to need covering to stop them splitting. Front teeth sometimes do not. We will tell you which category yours falls into.What happens if I leave it?The infection does not resolve on its own. It typically spreads into the bone around the root, which can lead to an abscess, facial swelling and eventually losing the tooth. Treated early it is a simpler procedure with a better outcome.What does a root canal cost in Pune?It depends on which tooth - front teeth have fewer canals than molars - and on whether a crown is needed afterwards. You get both figures in writing after the X-ray, before anything begins.I am dreading this. Can you do anything about that?Tell us when you book. We schedule more time, explain each step before it happens rather than narrating it afterwards, and stop the moment you raise a hand. A lot of people here have avoided a dentist for years; nobody will comment on it.

**Current SSR text**

About Full Mouth Rehabilitation in KothrudFull Mouth Rehabilitation (FMR) is a comprehensive treatment protocol designed for patients with extensive dental damage — including multiple missing teeth, generalized tooth wear, collapsed bite, or failing crowns, bridges, and fillings from previous dental work. When these issues go untreated, they can affect chewing efficiency, jaw joint health, and long-term oral function, not just appearance.As a prosthodontist-led treatment, Full Mouth Rehabilitation follows a structured diagnostic process — evaluating occlusion (bite alignment), tooth proportions, jaw relationship, and facial symmetry before any restorative work begins. This ensures that smile design decisions are grounded in function, not aesthetics alone.Treatment is sequenced in carefully planned stages, allowing the bite to be rebuilt incrementally and predictably. This staged approach reduces patient discomfort, allows for functional testing at each phase, and results in a restoration that is both durable and naturally proportioned to your face.Patients come to us for this from Erandwane and Bavdhan, and distance matters less here than for anything else we do. Full mouth work is months of staged appointments, so people choose on who is planning it rather than on how far they are driving.

**Current SSR text**

FAQsCommon questionsHow do I know if I need full mouth rehabilitation rather than a few crowns?The usual signs are wear across many teeth rather than one, repeated failure of existing crowns and fillings, difficulty chewing on either side, or jaw and muscle discomfort. If the problems are isolated, you do not need this - and we would rather tell you that than sell you a treatment plan.How long does it take?Months rather than weeks, planned in phases. The exact number depends on how much is being rebuilt and whether implants or grafting are part of it. You get the staging at the planning visit.Will I be without teeth at any point?No. The sequence is built specifically so you keep a working, presentable set of teeth throughout, using temporary restorations between phases where needed.Can I stop partway through?Yes. That is the point of phasing it. Each phase is designed to leave you in a stable state, so pausing between phases for financial or personal reasons does not undo the work already done.Why does this need a prosthodontist?Because the difficulty is not any one restoration, it is making them work together. A prosthodontist has three additional years of training specifically in restoring and replacing teeth, including how the bite and jaw joints behave when you change the height of it.Is it painful?The individual procedures are done under anaesthetic and are comparable to having crowns or implants placed. The bigger factor is that there are more appointments, which is tiring rather than painful. We space them to suit you.What does full mouth rehabilitation cost in Pune?It varies more than any other treatment we offer, because no two cases involve the same number of teeth or the same mix of crowns, implants and dentures. You get a phase-by-phase written estimate before anything starts.

**Current SSR text**

About Tooth-Coloured Fillings in KothrudTooth-coloured fillings, also known as composite resin restorations, treat cavities while preserving as much of your natural tooth as possible. The composite material is custom shade-matched to your enamel before application, so the repair blends invisibly into your smile.What sets composite resin apart from traditional silver amalgam fillings is how it attaches to the tooth. Amalgam fillings rely on mechanical retention, often requiring removal of healthy tooth structure just to hold the filling in place. Composite resin, by contrast, bonds directly to the tooth at a micro-mechanical level — allowing us to take a more conservative approach, removing only the decayed portion rather than reshaping the tooth around the filling.The composite is applied and hardened in thin layers using a curing light, which minimizes shrinkage and creates a tight seal at the edges of the restoration — reducing the risk of leakage or decay returning around the filling later. The result is a restoration that's not just cosmetically seamless, but also restores the tooth's natural strength and function, typically completed in a single visit with no metal, mercury, or dark spots.Everyday restorative work here is done by Dr. Aishwarya Kulkarni Wathodkar, BDS, Bharati Vidyapeeth, Pune, a general and family dentist. Most of these patients are simply local — Kothrud and the Paud Road side — because for a half-hour appointment nobody sensibly drives across Pune.

FAQsCommon questionsHow are these different from silver fillings?They are composite resin rather than amalgam, matched to your tooth shade so they are effectively invisible. They also bond to the tooth, which means less healthy tooth needs to be cut away to hold them in place.How long do tooth-coloured fillings last?Commonly five to ten years, often longer. It depends on where the filling is, how heavily you bite on it, whether you grind your teeth, and how well the area is cleaned.Does having a filling hurt?Shallow fillings often need no anaesthetic at all. Deeper ones are done under local anaesthetic and you should feel pressure rather than pain. If you would rather be numb regardless, just say so.Should I replace my old metal fillings?Not automatically. A sound amalgam filling that is not leaking, cracked or decaying underneath is usually best left alone - replacing it means removing more tooth. If yours does need replacing, we will show you the reason on the X-ray.Can a filling fix a chipped front tooth?Often, yes. Composite bonding can rebuild a chipped edge in one visit. For larger fractures or heavily worn front teeth, a veneer or crown may hold up better, and we will tell you which applies.My tooth is sensitive after a filling. Is that normal?Mild sensitivity to cold for a week or two is common, especially with deeper fillings. What is not normal is pain on biting or sensitivity that worsens - that usually means the filling is fractionally high or the nerve is irritated. Come back and we will check it.

About Wisdom Tooth Removal in KothrudWisdom teeth — the last molars to emerge, usually between ages 17 and 25 — often don't have enough room to grow in properly. They can become impacted, angled, or push against neighbouring teeth, making this one of the most common reasons patients visit us at Aesthedent.Left untreated, an impacted wisdom tooth can lead to recurrent infections, cyst formation, bone loss, or damage to adjacent teeth. Persistent jaw pain, swelling, or difficulty opening the mouth are common warning signs.At Aesthedent, every extraction begins with a detailed clinical evaluation, including digital X-rays to assess the tooth's exact position, root structure, and proximity to nerves — this allows us to plan the safest and least invasive approach for your specific case. The procedure itself is performed under local anaesthesia, so you remain comfortable throughout.Our approach favours minimally invasive surgical techniques wherever possible, which typically means less swelling, a shorter recovery, and fewer post-operative complications. Before you leave, you'll receive clear, personalised aftercare instructions — covering pain management, diet, and warning signs to watch for — so your recovery stays on track.Not every wisdom tooth needs removing: one that has erupted cleanly, bites against its opposite number and can be brushed is best left alone. Most of these patients come from nearby — Karve Nagar and Warje mainly — since a short trip home matters more on this one than on anything else we do.

**Current SSR text**

FAQsCommon questionsDoes every wisdom tooth need to come out?No. A wisdom tooth that has erupted fully, bites against the tooth above or below it and can be cleaned properly is better left in place. Removal is for teeth that are impacted, repeatedly infected, decayed, or damaging the tooth in front.Does the removal hurt?It is done under local anaesthetic, which is tested before starting. You will feel firm pressure and movement - that is expected and is not pain. Discomfort afterwards is managed with prescribed painkillers.Is painless wisdom tooth removal actually possible?“Painless wisdom tooth removal” is the phrase most people search, so it is worth answering plainly. Under local anaesthetic the extraction itself should not be painful - you will feel firm pressure and movement, which is a different sensation. What we cannot promise is the recovery: expect two or three days of swelling and soreness, managed with prescribed painkillers. Anyone guaranteeing you feel nothing at all is overselling it.How long is the recovery?Typically two to three days of swelling and soreness, easing over about a week. Lower impacted teeth take longer than simple upper ones. Plan a quiet couple of days rather than assuming you will be back to normal that evening.What can I eat afterwards?Soft, cool food for the first day or two, then build back up as it settles. Avoid drinking through a straw, smoking, and poking the socket - those are the things that most often disturb healing.Should I bring someone with me?For a straightforward upper wisdom tooth, most people drive themselves home fine. For a lower impacted one, it is worth arranging a lift - not because you will be incapacitated, but because it is more comfortable than managing traffic with a numb, sore jaw.What happens if I keep putting it off?An impacted wisdom tooth that keeps getting infected tends to keep getting infected. Left long enough it can decay the healthy molar in front of it, which turns one extraction into two problems. Earlier removal is generally the simpler procedure.

**Current SSR text**

About Orthodontic Treatment in KothrudIt's never too late to invest in your smile. Whether you're a teenager, a young professional, or even in your 40s, modern orthodontic options allow for treatment that fits discreetly into your daily life without disrupting your work, appearance, or confidence.At Aesthedent, every orthodontic case begins with a clinical evaluation of your bite, jaw alignment, and tooth positioning — not a one-size-fits-all recommendation. This assessment determines which treatment approach will give you the most predictable, stable result for your specific case.Which option is right for you depends on the complexity of your case, your treatment goals, and your lifestyle — something we determine together during your initial consultation, not before it.Treatment duration varies by case but typically averages 18 to 24 months. Throughout this period, we schedule regular monitoring visits — generally every 4 to 6 weeks — to track progress, make adjustments, and ensure your treatment stays on course. That cadence is why nearly all of our orthodontic patients live close by, in Kothrud and Karve Nagar: over a two-year course, ten minutes each way is the difference between keeping appointments and quietly abandoning them.At the end there is a retainer, and it is not optional. Teeth drift back if nothing holds them.Types of orthodontic treatment we offerMetal bracesThe most time-tested and versatile option, effective for both simple and complex misalignments, including cases involving significant crowding or bite correction.Ceramic bracesFunction like metal braces but use tooth-coloured brackets, offering a less visible alternative for patients who want effective correction with a more discreet appearance.Clear alignersA series of custom, removable trays that gradually shift teeth into position. Best suited for mild-to-moderate misalignment, and popular among working professionals for their near-invisibility and convenience.

<details>
<summary>Implemented text, actions and assets</summary>

**Current SSR text**

FAQsCommon questionsAm I too old for braces?No. Teeth move through bone by the same mechanism at any age, so adult orthodontics is entirely routine. It can take somewhat longer than in a teenager, and clear aligners make it far less conspicuous at work.How long does treatment take?Commonly eighteen months to two years, though simple cases finish sooner and complex ones run longer. You will get an estimate for your case before you commit, not a generic range.How often will I need to come in?Roughly every four to six weeks for an adjustment. The appointments themselves are short. It is the cumulative travel over two years that people underestimate, which is worth factoring in when choosing a practice.Braces or clear aligners - which is better?Neither, in the abstract. Fixed braces give more predictable control for complex movements and work whether you cooperate or not. Aligners are removable and discreet but only work while worn, which realistically means about twenty-two hours a day. The honest question is which suits your case and your habits.Does it hurt?Not the fitting itself. For a few days after fitting and after each adjustment the teeth feel tender and biting into hard food is uncomfortable. It settles, and ordinary painkillers cover it.What is the right age for a child to be assessed?Around seven is the usual recommendation for a first look, because that is when problems with the developing bite become visible. That does not mean treatment starts then - most begins between ten and fourteen, once enough permanent teeth are through.Do I really have to wear a retainer afterwards?Yes. Teeth have a strong tendency to drift back toward where they started, particularly in the first year. A retainer is what holds the result. Skipping it is the single most common reason people end up needing treatment twice.What do braces cost in Pune?It depends on which appliance and how long the case runs - aligners and fixed braces are priced differently. You get the full figure, retainers included, before anything is fitted.

About Dentures in KothrudAt Aesthedent, every case begins with a clinical evaluation of your jaw ridge, muscle attachments, and remaining natural teeth (if any) before we decide which type of denture is right for you.Standard dentures often look like "false teeth" and lack stability — a common complaint we hear from patients who've been fitted elsewhere. Our approach corrects this at the design stage: a natural gum-shade match, anatomically accurate tooth arrangement, and a bite registration process using a facial bow that restores your youthful facial contours rather than just filling a gap.Whether you need a single-arch complete denture, a cast metal partial, or a flexible partial, the treatment is planned and reviewed personally by Dr. Sahil Wathodkar, BDS, MDS (Prosthodontics), Bharati Vidyapeeth, Pune, from impression to final fit.Many of our denture patients come from Deccan and Erandwane, and several are brought by family. The cast metal framework distributes chewing force more evenly, fits with greater precision, and is significantly more durable and hygienic than acrylic-only alternatives.Flexible partial denturesA metal-free, flexible-resin option for patients who want a lighter, more comfortable partial denture, with clasps that blend naturally into the gumline — ideal for a more discreet, aesthetic solution.

FAQsCommon questionsWill they look like false teeth?That depends on how the teeth are set, which is why there is a try-in stage. Shade, length and arrangement are all chosen against your face and your age, and you see them in wax and approve them before the final set is made.How long does the whole process take?Usually four to five appointments spread over a few weeks. The records and the try-in are what take the time, and rushing them is what produces dentures that do not fit.Will I be able to eat normally?You will manage a much wider diet than without them, but a denture is not the same as natural teeth - expect to start with softer food and build up, and expect the first couple of weeks to feel strange. Lower dentures are harder to stabilise than upper ones, which is worth knowing in advance.Will they affect my speech?For a short while, yes. Most people find certain sounds awkward for the first week or two and then stop noticing. Reading aloud at home speeds it up considerably.What is the difference between a full and a partial denture?A full denture replaces all the teeth in a jaw and is held by suction and muscle control. A partial replaces some of them and is supported by the teeth that remain - so it has to be designed carefully to avoid overloading them.Can implants make a loose lower denture stable?Often, yes. A small number of implants can be used to secure a lower denture, which is the arrangement most people find transformative because lower dentures are the ones that tend to move. Whether it suits you depends on the bone available, which the scan shows.Do they need adjusting after fitting?Almost always. You cannot tell how a denture behaves until you have chewed with it, so a couple of adjustment visits are part of the normal process rather than a sign of a problem. Sore spots should be adjusted, not endured.How do I look after them?Clean them over a basin of water so they survive being dropped, brush them daily with a denture brush rather than toothpaste, and leave them out overnight so the tissues underneath recover. Bring them to your reviews.

**Current SSR text**

About Digital Smile Design in KothrudMost patients considering a smile makeover have the same question: what if I don't like the result? Digital Smile Design (DSD) exists to remove that uncertainty entirely — not through guesswork, but through a structured, evidence-based planning protocol used in cosmetic and restorative dentistry.At Aesthedent, the process begins with high-resolution facial and intraoral photography, video analysis of your natural smile and speech patterns, and 3D intraoral scanning. This data is mapped against established facial esthetic parameters — your midline, smile line, lip dynamics, and gingival architecture — to build a precise digital blueprint of your new smile, calibrated to your face rather than a generic template.From this blueprint, we fabricate a physical mock-up you can wear and evaluate in function: speaking, smiling, biting, looking in the mirror — all before a single tooth is prepared or any permanent restoration is placed. This step lets both you and your dentist assess esthetics, phonetics, and occlusion in real time, and correct anything digitally rather than irreversibly.The result: a smile that's biomechanically and esthetically integrated with your natural anatomy — one you've already seen, tried on, and approved, long before it becomes permanent.Smile design work here is planned by Dr. Sahil Wathodkar, BDS, MDS (Prosthodontics), Bharati Vidyapeeth, Pune, whose specialist training covers exactly this: how replacement teeth should be shaped, proportioned and arranged. Cosmetic work draws patients from further afield than routine treatment — Deccan and Erandwane in our case — because it is elective and people choose deliberately.

**Current SSR text**

FAQsCommon questionsIs Digital Smile Design a treatment?No, it is a planning method. It determines what the final result should look like, and the treatment that follows might be veneers, crowns, bonding, orthodontics or a combination. Planning it first is what stops the result being a surprise.What is the mock-up?The approved design placed in your mouth in a temporary material, without cutting your teeth. You can see it, speak with it and take it home for a day. It is the difference between imagining a result and looking at one.Can I change my mind about the design?That is the entire purpose of the process. Changes at the design and mock-up stage cost time only. Changes after teeth have been prepared are expensive and sometimes not fully reversible, which is why we front-load the decisions.Will my teeth look fake?Only if they are designed that way. Uniform, very white, identically shaped teeth are what read as artificial. Designing against your facial proportions and leaving natural variation is what avoids it - and you approve the look before anything is made.Does any part of it hurt?The planning does not. Photographs, scanning and the mock-up are all non-invasive and involve no anaesthetic. Any discomfort belongs to the treatment that follows, and we will explain that separately once the plan is agreed.Do I need to have every tooth done?Usually not. The design shows how far back the treatment realistically needs to go for the result to look even, which is often fewer teeth than people expect. If we think you are proposing more work than you need, we will say so.What does Digital Smile Design cost in Pune?The planning and the treatment that follows are costed separately, because the treatment varies enormously depending on what the design calls for. You get both figures before committing to anything beyond the initial consultation.

Choosing the right professional for your dental implants is a decision that affects your health for decades. Here is why a Specialist Prosthodontist is the Gold Standard for implant care. What is a Prosthodontist? A Prosthodontist is a dentist who has completed three additional years of advanced training and residency after dental school. They specialize in the restoration and replacement of teeth, making them the "architects" of dental treatment plans. The Specialist Advantage Architectural Planning: We don't just place an implant; we plan the entire biomechanical harmony of your mouth. Advanced Biomechanics: Ensuring your bite is healthy, comfortable, and natural-feeling. Complex Case Management: Expertise in handling bone loss, full-mouth rehabilitations, and aesthetic challenges. Material Expertise: Knowledge of the latest biocompatible materials for long-term success. Why Specialization Matters for Implants Dental implants are not just a surgical procedure; they are a restorative one. A Prosthodontist ensures that the final tooth (the crown) is perfectly aligned with the implant and your natural bite, preventing future complications like implant failure or jaw pain. What to expect at Aesthedent Every implant case here is planned by our prosthodontist in Kothrud, Dr. Sahil Wathodkar, BDS, MDS (Prosthodontics), Bharati Vidyapeeth, Pune. Our process includes: Comprehensive 3D digital diagnostic mapping Specialist-led surgical and restorative planning Planning of the final tooth before the implant goes in, not after Ongoing monitoring at review appointments If you already know replacement is what you need, the practical detail - what the procedure involves, how long each stage takes and what affects the cost - is on our dental implants in Kothrud page. Have questions?Our team is here to help you understand your dental health better.Chat with us

<details>
<summary>Implemented text, actions and assets</summary>

**Current SSR text**

The phrase "root canal" often triggers fear, but modern root canal treatment is nothing like the horror stories. Here is the truth about what to expect. The myth vs. reality The biggest misconception about root canals is that they are extremely painful. In reality, root canal treatment relieves pain-it does not cause it. The pain you feel before treatment is from the infected tooth, not the procedure itself. What modern technology has changed Today's root canal procedures benefit from: Advanced anesthesia: More effective numbing techniques Precise imaging: 3D scans for accurate treatment Modern instruments: Faster, more efficient cleaning Better materials: Superior sealing and filling options What to actually expect Most patients describe the experience as similar to getting a filling. You will feel pressure but not pain. The procedure typically takes 1-2 hours, and you can return to normal activities the same day. After the procedure Some mild discomfort for a few days is normal and can be managed with over-the-counter pain medication. This is far less than the pain of an untreated infected tooth. If the fear is what has kept you away Say so when you book - it changes how we run the appointment, not how we judge you. We talk through each step before it happens, and if you raise a hand at any point we stop. Plenty of people here have avoided a dentist for years. If you want the clinical detail first, our root canal treatment in Kothrud page walks through the stages, and what we do for patients who are frightened of the dentist covers the rest. Have questions?Our team is here to help you understand your dental health better.Chat with us

Finding the right dentist is about more than just location. Here is what to look for when choosing a dentist in Kothrud, Pune. Qualifications and experience Check for proper dental qualifications (BDS, MDS) and look for dentists with specialized training in areas relevant to your needs. Experience matters, especially for complex procedures. Red flags to watch for Pushing unnecessary treatments Unclear pricing or hidden costs Rushing through appointments Not explaining procedures clearly Outdated equipment or facilities Questions to ask During your first visit, ask about: Treatment options and alternatives Complete cost breakdown Emergency availability Sterilization practices Payment plans or insurance acceptance The importance of comfort A good dentist makes you feel comfortable and heard. They should take time to explain things, answer your questions, and never make you feel rushed or judged. How we measure up Everything above is a fair test to put us through too. Our treatment planning is done by an MDS-qualified prosthodontist, we show you the scan and explain what we have found before anything starts, and you can stop us at any point by raising a hand. If that is the kind of practice you are looking for, you can book a consultation with our dentist in Kothrud, read how we work with nervous patients, or check where our dental clinic in Kothrud actually is before you commit to anything. Have questions?Our team is here to help you understand your dental health better.Chat with us

Everyone wants a brighter smile, but is teeth whitening safe? Here is what you need to know about professional whitening versus at-home options. Professional vs. at-home whitening Professional whitening uses higher-concentration peroxide gels under controlled conditions, making it both safer and more effective than most at-home options. Is it safe for enamel? When done correctly, professional teeth whitening does not damage enamel. The key is proper application and not overdoing treatments. However, overuse of whitening products can lead to sensitivity and enamel wear. What dentists recommend Get a dental checkup before whitening Use professional-grade products Follow recommended treatment schedules Avoid excessive whitening Maintain results with good oral hygiene Managing sensitivity Some sensitivity after whitening is normal and temporary. Using a desensitizing toothpaste before and after treatment can help minimize discomfort. Have questions?Our team is here to help you understand your dental health better.Chat with us

Dental anxiety is more common than you think. At Aesthedent, we have developed specific approaches to help anxious patients feel comfortable and in control. Understanding dental anxiety Fear of the dentist often stems from past negative experiences, fear of pain, or feeling out of control. Recognizing these triggers is the first step to addressing them. How we help at Aesthedent Clear communication: We explain everything before we do it Control signals: Raise your hand anytime to pause Comfortable environment: Calming music and a relaxed atmosphere Gentle techniques: Modern, minimally invasive approaches Sedation options: For those who need extra help relaxing Tips for managing anxiety Before your appointment: Share your fears with your dentist Schedule morning appointments when you are less tired Bring headphones and calming music Practice deep breathing exercises Consider bringing a supportive friend or family member Have questions?Our team is here to help you understand your dental health better.Chat with us

## 8. Recommended target architecture

Recommendations only; not implemented or implicitly authorized.

### Retain existing entities and IDs

Keep insight (six stable slugs), service (eight stable slugs), doctor (two identities) and testimonial (six existing review slots). Keep homePage/aboutPage/experiencePage types and fixed document IDs. Do not rename stored fields for cosmetic labels. Shared collection data should not be copied into page documents.

### Finite homepage editorial coverage

If approved, extend the existing homePage in named objects: hero eyebrow/headline/supportingCopy; treatments heading/intro; appointment introduction; visit existing fields; team heading/intro and four promise explanations; reviews and Insights section headings/introductions; contact invitation. Fixed counts, icons, images, CTA destinations/tracking and section ordering remain code. A hero heading must preserve accessible/plain representation plus animated presentation; do not simply replace animated JSX with arbitrary rich text. Shared entities remain their own documents. Use optional new fields and per-section fallback until approved copy exists.

### Proposed homepage field contract (unimplemented)

Optional named section objects preserve old documents: hero{eyebrow:string≤120,heading:string≤200,supportingCopy:text≤2000}; treatments{heading:string≤200,intro:text≤2000}; appointment{heading:string≤200,intro:text≤2000}; team{heading:string≤200,intro:text≤2000,promises:exactly4{id:fixed enum of current promise positions,title:string≤180,desc:text≤2000}}; reviews{heading:string≤200,intro:text≤2000}; insights{heading:string≤200,intro:text≤2000}; contact{heading:string≤200,intro:text≤2000}. Reuse current visit fields and stage identities, no duplication. New section present means its required children must be complete, nonblank plain text; malformed section retains that section’s static fallback. Clinical/promissory copy still needs review. Section visibility/order, collections, brand line, fact bar, assets, actions and URL destinations stay code. Optional action labels≤80 only if staff editing need is confirmed; do not expose hrefs as arbitrary URLs.

### Other page-owned coverage

Extend aboutPage only for existing nonfactual section introductions/inclusivity descriptions and closing invitation; extend experiencePage only for existing nonfactual guarantees/section introductions. Use headings:string≤200 and paragraphs:text≤2000; fixed existing card counts, semantic keys and plain-text rendering. A separate simple contact/local-page informational singleton is justified only after staff requests regular updates; avoid one giant siteContent document. Service-owned FAQs and Experience FAQs remain nested in their owner, not duplicate global FAQ records.

### Protected facts and operational configuration

Keep clinic identity, names/credentials/registration, provider roster/capabilities, patient/clinical counts, rating totals, quotation permissions, hours/NAP, geographic coordinates and canonical origin code/review-controlled until conflicts are resolved. A future clinicSettings proposal must own both visible and structured-data consumers and have explicit clinic approval. Navigation routes/labels, footer curated links, intake form branching/options/validation, WhatsApp transport, analytics, animation and responsive image behavior stay code.

### Media, SEO and freshness

Retain static assets for this finite architecture; add native image/alt/crop/hotspot only on a demonstrated editorial need with asset provenance. Maintain service metadata/FAQ JSON-LD and Insight metadata/sitemap from the same validated source. Keep canonical paths/static route registry and no implicit localized routes. Existing published-only readers, explicit projections, Zod boundary and60-second request-driven cache remain; webhook or draft preview is a separately authorized future capability, not required by this audit.

## 9. Migration and implementation sequence

No migration or implementation ran. Actual remote document IDs for ordinary types remain unknown; never substitute slugs as IDs without inventory. Schema labels/help do not require data rewrites. Stored field/type changes and permission/clinical workflow changes require separate review.

### M0 — confirm decisions and inventory remote revisions

No writes. Confirm A01 Featured semantics; A02/A03 factual claims/providers/registration; A04 quotation permission/review policy; finite section coverage and asset provenance. In exact ae09qs5c/production, authorized read inventory must include published/drafts/releases and IDs/revisions; current empty list/new-state UI is not a complete remote export. Acceptance: clinic/editor decisions recorded and source-to-document ownership agreed.

### M1 — presentation-only Studio improvements

Affected types: all seven; existing IDs unchanged. Change titles/descriptions/groups/previews only after approval; call out shared consumers, fixed record lists, array limits and formatted-text semantics. No stored-name/type migration. Reader unchanged; original schema/config diff is rollback. Acceptance: compiled validation tests and read-only editor review, no frontend differences.

### M2 — additive bounded homepage coverage

Affected type homePage; fixed published ID homePage and draft drafts.homePage; any versions.* record requires separate release review, never bulk patch. Add optional named objects preserving existing visitHeading/visitQuote/visitSteps. Compatibility reader accepts old payloads, validates each new section only when present, preserves existing section fallback and all shared collection policies. Do not seed medical/promissory wording automatically. Acceptance: identical empty/old/new-invalid fallback pages, complete optional section tests, accessible animated hero tests if included, shared consumers/SEO unchanged.

### M3 — additive page sections and optional semantic identities

Affected aboutPage/drafts.aboutPage and experiencePage/drafts.experiencePage; future static card IDs may require mapping old array indices to explicit known keys. Preserve old positional reader until every reviewed document is verified. Never infer content semantics from a renamed title. Service aboutList and all fixed slugs remain unchanged. Acceptance: old and new shape tests, exact counts/icons/order, unchanged route/metadata snapshots. No new contact/gallery/settings types without a demonstrated requirement.
